customUiPage.emptyHint: Create a component folder (for example, my-card) in the directory below with manifest.json (runtime: native) and component.js, or ask an agent to generate one with component_create. Native components run in the app’s origin; declared capabilities only describe them and gate network and storage access.
customUiPage.directoryLocationHint: This path belongs to the connected Pisper service. For a remote connection, create the component files on the server.
customUiPage.selectComponent: Pick a component on the left to preview it
widget.catalogFailed: Installed components could not be loaded. Please retry.
floating.moveHint: Hold to drag; use arrow keys to move, Shift for larger steps, or Home to return to the top.
moved.title: Components moved to Features › Component studio →
moved.hint: Preview, placement and generation are managed on the Components page
phone.missingHint: It may have been removed or renamed. Go back to the list to choose again, or rescan.
host.safeModeHint: Components are not loaded in safe mode.
host.pausedHint: This component failed 3 times in 60 seconds and was paused.
host.renderErrorTitle: Render failed; this component was isolated
host.loadErrorTitle: Component failed to load and was isolated
tool.notPlacedTitle: This component is not placed on a feature page
tool.notPlacedHint: Place it on “Feature page” in the component studio to open it here as a full page.
floating.closeFailed: Could not close the floating component. Please retry.
safeMode.promptTitle: The page may have frozen while loading components last time
safeMode.promptHint: No components have been loaded yet. Keep safe mode (placeholders only), load them normally, or disable every native component and check them one by one on the Components page.
safeMode.disableFailed: Some components could not be disabled. Check them on the Components page.
studio.deleteHint: The component folder, its placements and its storage move to the custom-ui-trash folder in the data directory instead of being erased right away.
studio.toggleFailed: Could not change whether it is enabled. Please retry.
studio.invalidHint: Fix manifest.json or the files listed above; it is checked again automatically after you save.
studio.brokenTitle: This folder is not a readable component
studio.brokenHint: manifest.json is missing or cannot be parsed. It shows up here once fixed, or you can delete it.
studio.unsupportedTitle: The connected service does not support native components
studio.unsupportedHint: Update Pisper on that device, then open Components again. Legacy iframe components are no longer supported.
errors.manifest_not_object: manifest.json must be a JSON object
errors.component_too_large: Too many or too large files (≤128 files, 16 MB)
